# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow the repository-wide instructions in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).

Before implementing a task:
- Read `AGENTS.md` and the relevant sections of `README.md`.
- Inspect the current code and tests; do not assume documentation reflects every recent change.
- For authentication work, use [`docs/TODO_AUTHENTICATION.md`](../docs/TODO_AUTHENTICATION.md) as the task checklist and update it as verified work is completed.

Keep changes focused, preserve existing behaviour, add or update tests, and never claim unverified work is complete.
